messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Latency SLO breach detected for /v1/generate in us-west-2 · p95 jumped from ~420ms -> ~1.2s, p99 from ~2.8s -> ~8.5s over the last 2m. Streaming stalls + incomplete chunking spikes. Auto-runbook invoked: /runbooks/kv-cache-pressure. @marta you were assigned. :rotating_light:

marta (oncall): I'm on it. pulling kv cache metrics and runtime traces now. noticing a big jump in kv_evictions/sec and fragment_count on nodes serving seq_len>1024.

dmitri (infra): logs look like heavy prefill traffic from a small set of customers, causing excessive cache churn. evictions are correlated with prefill.enqueue rate.

samir (runtime): streaming stalls look like decode tasks waiting on KV misses. prefill happens too aggressively for long-context requests -> eviction thrash -> subsequent decode suffers tail latency.

marta (oncall): confirmed. top query distribution: 4 customers produce ~60% of large-context prefill load. hit_rate dropped from 0.92 -> 0.65.

elaine (eng-sre): copying mitigations from runbook: 1) disable prefill for streaming requests globally (temp) 2) increase KV cache size on affected pools 3) route heavy requests to fallback model variant (lower mem) 4) throttle concurrency for streaming ondedicated pools. Which one can we action fast?

marta (oncall): quickest is disable prefill flag and route heavy streams away. I'll push a config toggle to the control plane and update routing policy.

samir (runtime): I can flip the flag. patch: 
```
# disable aggressive prefill
ENV REDWOOD_KV_PREFILL=0
// or API: POST /admin/kv/prefill?enabled=false
```
I'll also raise decode worker concurrency from 32 -> 48 on the affected host pool as short term.

dmitri (infra): bumping cache allocation now for pool usw2-pool-3: +25% memory. watch for OOMs.

marta (oncall): making the routing change to divert requests with seq_len>1024 to fallback-fast-quant variant (no streaming). Applying now.

incident-bot: ACTION: config change submitted by samir. Change-id: cfg-1865432100-3. Watch metrics for 5m.

marta (oncall): initial impact checks: p95 improving at 2m post-change: 1.2s -> 580ms, p99 trending down from 8.5s -> 3.4s, streaming stall rate halved. customer visible errors reduced. still not at SLO.

elaine (eng-sre): customer impact summary for posterity: ~12% of streaming requests in last hour experienced >2s tails; ~3% token generation failures for 5 customers (Acme, Nebula Labs, Pollux, Helix AI, DataForge). CS notified via incidents channel.

raj (oncall-next): I'm watching dashboards. If p99 doesn't drop below 2s within 20m we should consider autoscaling extra pool and a temporary CANARY redirect for 10% traffic to a lower-memory but higher-throughput variant.

samir (runtime): I'll prepare the canary config and a quick rollback. also suggest a medium-term fix: tune prefill heuristics to bias against prefill when eviction_rate>threshold and prefer decode-first strategy for streaming.

marta (oncall): agree. I'll open a follow-up ticket for prefill heuristic changes + eval. For now, mitigation steps taken: 
- REDWOOD_KV_PREFILL disabled (global) 
- us-west-2 pool memory +25% 
- seq_len>1024 routing -> fallback-fast-quant (no streaming) 
- decode workers increased on 3 hosts

marta (oncall): handing off to @raj in 18m. I'll post a brief incident note in #incidents and update the runbook with actions/time. If anything regresses ping me directly.

raj (oncall-next): acknowledged. I'll take over at 18:00 UTC and continue monitoring. quick checklist on handoff: confirm p99<2s, evictions/sec stabilizing, no OOM events, customers ACK.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigation in progress · severity: SEV2 · link: /incidents/1865432100-kv-latency-spike

marta (oncall): small follow-up: stack traces show decode tasks waiting ~1200ms on KV lookup for certain keys with high fragmentation. We'll add a KV warmup job for heavy customers as part of remediation.

elaine (eng-sre): noted. I'll coordinate CS for follow-up communication and post-mortem timeline.

marta (oncall): closing temporary alert for now, continuing watch. handoff to @raj in 18m. :thumbsup:
